cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get us a proper price for your signed guitar. Would you let me sell it so we can replace the fridge?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I queued all night for that signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we won't treat it like a second-hand instrument. You can write the history for the advert, and I'll make the price reflect it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sell the case. The guitar stays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the case for the memory. Let me bring you an offer for the guitar before you decide; you can refuse any amount. I'll handle the selling, but I need you to choose the price you could live with.

reason: Have A yield final price and refusal rights to keep negotiation cooperative after B case-only boundary, while still asking for a path to surrender the valued guitar.
